fact: The Eswatini Revenue Service launched its Integrated Payment Solution with FNB Eswatini on 12 June 2026, so customs duties and import VAT can be paid through the bank; domestic tax payments are the next phase.
Eswatini Positive News reports the Eswatini Revenue Service launched the Tax Ease portal, working from 4 March 2024, with integrated payments for taxpayers to pay their taxes.
